LanguageData.SmartHaul_EnableHarvest_Desc: Pick up items after harvesting plants.
LanguageData.SmartHaul_EnableMining_Desc: Pick up items after mining ore and stone.
LanguageData.SmartHaul_EnableDeconstruct_Desc: Pick up items after deconstructing buildings.
LanguageData.SmartHaul_EnableFloorRemoval_Desc: Pick up items after removing floor coverings.
LanguageData.SmartHaul_EnableCrafting_Desc: Pick up products after completing recipes (butchering, crafting, cooking).
LanguageData.SmartHaul_CollectChunks_Desc: Enable picking up stone chunks and rubble into inventory.
LanguageData.SmartHaul_ImmediateHaulCrafting_Desc: After each completed recipe, immediately haul products to storage.
LanguageData.SmartHaul_ImmediateHaulFarming_Desc: After each plant harvest, immediately haul yield to storage.
LanguageData.SmartHaul_ThresholdHint: Pawn hauls to storage when inventory reaches this fill level.
LanguageData.SmartHaul_BehaviorMining: Mining/deconstruction: pile nearby, haul to storage when full.
LanguageData.SmartHaul_BehaviorFarming: Farming: haul to storage immediately or at threshold.
LanguageData.SmartHaul_BehaviorCrafting: Crafting: haul to storage immediately or at threshold.
LanguageData.SmartHaul_EnableSmartHauling_Desc: Pawns pick up nearby items while hauling instead of one stack at a time.
LanguageData.SmartHaul_SmartHaulAutoHaul_Desc: Automatically use smart hauling for work-assigned haul jobs. Disable to use smart hauling only via right-click menu.
